title: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge

entities.name: Archie Dixon
entities.description: A courier hired by the Sterling Company who is killed by Akul's Hellspurs while carrying a sack of coal.

entities.name: Akul
entities.description: A dragon and feared leader of the Hellspurs who hunts for the last key.

entities.name: Hellspurs
entities.description: The outlaw gang led by the dragon Akul that ambushes and kills the Sterling guards and Archie.

entities.name: Sterling Company
entities.description: A wealthy company on Thunder Junction that hires couriers and mercenaries and has invested in Ral's research.

entities.name: Annie Flash
entities.description: A retired outlaw and former Freestrider who can see through illusions with her golden eye and lives in Saddlebrush with her palominos.

entities.name: Fortune
entities.description: Annie's horned, intelligent horse-like companion who comes and goes with the sunset.

entities.name: Mr. Towning
entities.description: The pepper-gray storekeeper of Saddlebrush who splits Annie's loot with her.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A fae shapeshifter and notorious trickster who recruits Annie for a heist on Akul, and Kellan's father.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A young fae from Eldraine working at Omenport who flew to catch a falling worker, and who is searching for his father Oko.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker developing a communication relay through the Omenpaths, who hires Kellan onto his security detail.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The dragon in Ravnica collaborating with Ral on communicating through the Omenpaths.

entities.name: Ezrim
entities.description: Kellan's former boss, who told him his father was on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Annie's nephew
entities.description: A nephew nearly killed by Akul, the reason Annie left outlaw life.

entities.name: Omenport
entities.description: A town on Thunder Junction built around an Omenpath, with a half-built relay tower.

entities.name: Saddlebrush
entities.description: A small, remote town in the wastes where Annie lives on a ranch.

entities.name: Prosperity
entities.description: The wealthiest town on Thunder Junction and headquarters of the Sterling Company.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: The Wild West plane of outlaws, deserts and Omenpaths where the story is set.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: A portal between planes, with one at Omenport crackling with blue energy.

entities.name: Relay tower
entities.description: A tower being built at Omenport to communicate through Omenpaths, which suffers a power surge.

entities.name: Freestriders
entities.description: An outlaw crew Annie rode with in her early days.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: Kellan's home plane.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Niv-Mizzet works with Ral on the Omenpath relay.

events.summary: Archie waits for an hour in Omenport until a masked stranger from another plane arrives through the Omenpath and hands him a burlap sack.
events.quote: In his outstretched fist was a burlap sack.

events.summary: Archie sets off across the desert in a carriage with two Sterling guards, expecting bandits.
events.quote: His employer would never have provided two Sterling Company guards unless the job carried risks.

events.summary: A wall of fire stops the carriage and the Hellspurs kill the Sterling guards.
events.quote: Nearly a dozen holes appeared across the side of the carriage, and the Sterling guards fell immediately.

events.summary: Akul splits the carriage, takes the sack and declares the last key his, but finds only coal and flies into a rage.
Archie dies in the burning sand while the real key gets farther away from Akul.
events.quote: For all he cared about punctuality, he never expected to be so early to his own death.

events.summary: Annie Flash follows the smoke on Fortune, recognises Akul's work in the burned carriage and finds an untouched lockbox of cash.
Annie deduces that the Hellspurs left the money because they were after something bigger.
events.quote: But they left the money behind—which meant they were after something else.

events.summary: Annie brings the lockbox to Mr. Towning and they split the cash fifty-fifty.
events.quote: Annie watched him divide the cash into two equal parts.

events.summary: Oko, disguised as a city man, approaches Annie on her porch and she sees through his illusion with her golden eye.
events.quote: My name is Oko—and your ability to see through illusions is exactly why I've been looking for you.

events.summary: Oko offers Annie revenge by recruiting her for a heist against Akul, and she refuses.
events.quote: I've been putting a team together to steal something important from an outlaw you may know as Akul.

events.summary: Oko leaves a saloon matchbook and hints that the Hellspurs could easily find her town.
events.quote: If it was this easy for me to find you, imagine how easy it will be if the Hellspurs ever decide to come looking.

events.summary: Annie realises her old ghosts have followed her to the only place she cares about.
events.quote: her old ghosts had followed her to the only place left in the world that she truly cared about.

events.summary: Kellan works at the half-built relay tower in Omenport and reflects on the Omenpath that brought him from Eldraine.
events.quote: It was hard to believe it had only been a few weeks since he'd stepped through the portal.

events.summary: A technician's fault sends lightning through the relay tower and a worker falls from the scaffolding.
events.quote: From the height of the tower, the man fell.

events.summary: Kellan flies up on golden dust and catches the falling worker midair.
events.quote: Golden dust burst from his feet as he flew toward the man and wrapped his arms around him midair

events.summary: Ral dismisses the accident and walks away without looking at the fallen worker.
events.quote: He marched away without another glance toward the fallen worker.

events.summary: Kellan tells the worker that Ezrim told him his father was on this plane and that he is looking for him.
events.quote: My last boss, Ezrim—he told me my dad was on this plane.

events.summary: The overseer reassigns Kellan to Ral's security detail for a trip to Sterling Company headquarters in Prosperity.
events.quote: Mr. Zarek thinks someone with your skillset should be on his security detail instead of working out here in the heat.

events.summary: Kellan hopes someone in Prosperity can tell him about Oko and resolves to meet his father.
events.quote: The odds of at least someone in the city having information about Oko were bound to be high.

relations.note: Akul is the dragon leader of the Hellspurs.
relations.quote: There was no mistaking the leader of the Hellspurs.

relations.note: Akul's attack leaves Archie dying in the carriage.
relations.quote: His mortality was slipping away with every staggered breath, eyes wide with panic.
since the day Akul almost killed her nephew

relations.note: Oko is Kellan's father, though they have never met.
relations.quote: Besides, he was Oko's son, and that meant something.

relations.note: Oko is putting together a team to steal from Akul.
relations.quote: I've been putting a team together to steal something important from an outlaw you may know as Akul.

relations.note: Annie and Fortune are well suited companions.
relations.quote: They were well suited to one another that way

relations.note: Annie splits her loot with Mr. Towning for the town's safety.
relations.quote: I'm not sure our little town would've survived this long if it hadn't been for you.

relations.note: Kellan is assigned to Ral's security detail.
relations.quote: Mr. Zarek thinks someone with your skillset should be on his security detail

relations.note: Ral and Niv-Mizzet develop an Omenpath communication method together.
relations.quote: Ral—along with Niv-Mizzet, back in Ravnica—was developing a way to communicate through the Omenpaths

relations.note: The Sterling Company invested in Ral's research and protects it with mercenaries.
relations.quote: The Sterling Company had already invested in Ral's research.

relations.note: Annie served with the Freestriders in her early days.
relations.quote: She'd seen plenty of carriage fires during her early days with the Freestriders.
